topic: Why your salary disappears by the 20th
title: Why Your Paycheck Is Gone a Week Later
hook_promise: Show where a paycheck really goes in the first week, and the simple payday split that makes it last till the next one.

beats.narration: Payday feels rich. So why are you broke a week later?
beats.visual_intent: A lead figure at the café table turns an empty wallet inside out while a wall calendar behind shows one circled payday and the week of days after it crossed off.

shot.image_prompt: Sunlit café, wooden round table, lead sits slightly slumped holding a thin empty wallet open toward the viewer, small worried eyes, a wall calendar with a blank grid on the wall behind, one day circled as payday and the seven days after it crossed off with X marks, green coffee cup, ivy and tall windows with golden light and dappled shadows.

beats.narration: Say $1,500 lands every other Friday. It feels huge.
beats.visual_intent: A glass jar on the table fills to the brim with golden coins while the lead looks on happily.

shot.image_prompt: Top-down view of the wooden café table, a large glass jar overflowing with shiny coins in the center, lead's mitten hands resting on either side of it, green cup nearby, warm golden light, terracotta tiles at the edge of the frame.

beats.narration: Then rent and bills take their bite in the first few days.
beats.visual_intent: Coins drain out of the same jar as a long receipt unrolls from it, and the lead watches the level drop.

shot.image_prompt: Close view of the same glass jar, coin level dropping, a stream of coins sliding out toward a long paper receipt unrolling across the wooden table, lead's face at the edge of the frame watching with a small frown, warm afternoon light.

beats.narration: Next come the small ones. Subscriptions. Coffee. Delivery. Each one feels like nothing.
beats.visual_intent: Small objects pile around the lead: a phone, a takeout box and a coffee cup, each nibbling a coin away while the lead shrugs.

shot.image_prompt: Medium shot at the café table, lead tapping a phone with one hand, a takeout box and a to-go coffee cup beside the jar, a few coins sliding off the jar rim, relaxed easy expression, warm sunlight through the window.
pose_variants: Lead shrugging with both mitten hands raised and a relaxed smile, same table, phone, takeout box and cup in place.

beats.narration: One small leak is nothing. Fifty small leaks empty the jar.
beats.visual_intent: The jar shows many tiny cracks with trickles of coins leaking out, the level nearly gone.

shot.image_prompt: Close insert of a glass jar with a few coins left at the bottom, many hairline cracks with thin trickles of coins slipping out onto the wooden table, warm golden light, soft shadow.

beats.narration: Here's the catch. You never see the total, because it's spread across the whole month.
beats.visual_intent: The lead and friend discover a receipt stretching across the café floor and out the door, and the lead is startled.

shot.image_prompt: Wide café scene, a very long paper receipt unrolled across the terracotta floor toward the green door, lead standing surprised with hands raised, friend in the teal scarf pointing along the paper, golden sunlight and dappled shadows.
pose_variants: Lead with a hand on the forehead, eyes wide, friend still pointing along the paper, same wide café frame.

beats.narration: You glance at the balance, not the pattern. A full account whispers, go ahead.
beats.visual_intent: The lead glances at a full-looking jar while behind it, unseen, coins trickle out of a hole at the back.

shot.image_prompt: Close shot of lead looking at a glass jar that appears full from the front, relaxed half-smile, while behind the jar a hidden side shows a small hole with coins trickling out, soft late-afternoon light.
pose_variants: Lead leaning back with a content smile and one mitten hand waving go ahead, same jar and light.

beats.narration: So split it on payday. Bills in one jar, then one spending jar for each week. When a jar's empty, you see it early.
beats.visual_intent: The lead pours coins from the big jar into one bills jar and two small weekly jars (one per week of the pay period) lined up on the table.

shot.image_prompt: Top-down view of the wooden table, one larger jar and two small matching jars in a neat row, lead's mitten hands pouring coins from a big jar into them, each jar holding a tidy share, warm golden light.

beats.narration: Payday feels rich. Make it last till the next one.
beats.visual_intent: Lead and friend clink green coffee cups in the café, with the calendar's circled day behind them and the jars still stocked.

shot.image_prompt: Wide sunlit café, lead and friend at the round table clinking green coffee cups with warm smiles, a row of jars still holding coins on the table, wall calendar with one circled day behind them, ivy, hanging lamp and golden light through tall windows.

edits.note: works for any US pay schedule: a week later, $1,500 every other Friday, two weekly jars, last till the next one
